summary.text: Mike Jones is a Republican state representative from Missouri House District 12, which he has represented since January 2025, and is the Republican candidate for Missouri Senate District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business owner and U.S. Air Force veteran.

paragraphs.text: Mike Jones served in the U.S. Air Force from 1997 to 2001.
He graduated from Park Hill High School in 1996 and earned a bachelor's degree in management and leadership from Friends University.
His career experience includes owning Elite Painting KC, and he also holds a Missouri real estate license.
